[[User:tsali|tsali]]:
I've drawn some small GIF pictures of the official Lojban symbol. Use them to link to the official Lojban web site, my Lojban pages, or anything else related to Lojban. Do what you want with them: resize, stretch, change the colours; I don't care. As long as you don't incorporate them in a nazi flag or something.

Please please please please: this is a low volume web server, and I may have to remove my web pages if traffic is too high. Don't link to the pictures here, make a local copy.
